title: A fix loop's plan (contract task-plan v1, Phase 4, D344, D349)
description: What the fixer planned for one ticket, as code checked it: each change's where, why and reach, and the test written first (D346). Reach is filled by code from the graph at the base commit (`graph impact --file`), never by the agent. Written by `stangent fix check` to .stangent/fix/<KEY>/task-plan.json.

baseCommit.description: The commit the plan's points and reach are read at.

test.description: The test that fails before the fix (D346): the bug proof's, committed first on the branch (D350).

failedBefore.description: The proof's failure message on the unchanged code.

point.description: The graph id at the base commit; null for a new file.

reach.description: The files `graph impact --file` reaches from this change's file at the base commit, the file itself left out.
